question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Final query: top-level packaging containers with items exceeding 500 total accumulated quantity
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of top-level packaging
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS path_qty
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr.contains_id,
        h.path_qty * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
-- Leaf items only (items not contained within any other packaging as containers)
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id, name FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
)
SELECT 
    h.top_name AS container_name,
    li.name AS item_name,
    SUM(h.path_qty) AS total_accumulated_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN leaf_items li ON li.id = h.current_id
GROUP BY h.top_name, li.name
HAVING SUM(h.path_qty) > 500
ORDER BY h.top_name, li.name
